**Pipeline controller notification**
This repo is configured to use the [pipeline controller](https://docs.ci.openshift.org/how-tos/creating-a-pipeline/). Second-stage tests will be triggered either automatically or after lgtm label is added, depending on the repository configuration. The pipeline controller will automatically detect which contexts are required and will utilize `/test` Prow commands to trigger the second stage.

For optional jobs, comment `/test ?` to see a list of all defined jobs. To trigger manually all jobs from second stage use `/pipeline required` command. 

This repository is configured in: LGTM mode

## Walkthrough Validation for AWS instance metadata IPv6 protocol was tightened in CAPI→MAPI conversion; MAPI→CAPI conversion and fuzz tests were adjusted accordingly. AWS-related sync logic now ignores differences in `httpProtocolIpv6` during machine/template comparisons. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**CAPI → MAPI conversion**
`pkg/conversion/capi2mapi/aws.go`|Adds validation rejecting `HTTPProtocolIPv6` values other than empty or `InstanceMetadataEndpointStateDisabled`, returning a `field.Invalid` for unsupported values.| |**Fuzz tests**
`pkg/conversion/capi2mapi/aws_fuzz_test.go`|Fuzz input updated to explicitly set `HTTPProtocolIPv6` to empty to align with the new validation.| |**MAPI → CAPI conversion**
`pkg/conversion/mapi2capi/aws.go`|Minor alignment/whitespace change around `HTTPEndpoint` assignment; conversion behavior remains (sets endpoint enabled).| |**Machineset sync controller**
`pkg/controllers/machinesetsync/machineset_sync_controller.go`|Adds an ignore-field option to exclude `spec.template.spec.instanceMetadataOptions.httpProtocolIpv6` from AWS infra machine template diffs.| |**Machine sync (mapi→capi) infra compare**
`pkg/controllers/machinesync/machine_sync_mapi2capi_infrastructure.go`|Excludes `spec.instanceMetadataOptions.httpProtocolIpv6` from AWS infra machine diffs so it doesn't count as a spec change.| ## Sequence Diagram(s) (omitted) ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 10 | ❌ 2 ### ❌ Failed checks (1 warning, 1 inconclusive) | Check name | Status | Explanation | Resolution | | :------------------------: | :------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Docstring Coverage | ⚠️ Warning | Docstring coverage is 60.00% which is insufficient. The required threshold is 80.00%. | Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold. | | Test Structure And Quality | ❓ Inconclusive | PR modifies only a fuzz test file with a single line change to HTTPProtocolIPv6 configuration. No Ginkgo tests exist in the repository. | Clarify whether this check applies to fuzz tests or only Ginkgo tests. If Ginkgo tests are expected, verify their locations and ensure they meet specified quality requirements. |
✅ Passed checks (10 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :----------------------------------------------: | :------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | Investigation found no Ginkgo test definitions with dynamic test names. PR modifies only non-test source files and a fuzz test file without Ginkgo patterns. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR does not add any new Ginkgo e2e tests, only modifies existing conversion functions and validation logic. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR does not add any new Ginkgo e2e tests; it only modifies conversion logic and controller behavior. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR modifies AWS infrastructure conversion logic and instance metadata options without introducing scheduling constraints incompatible with standard HA, SNO, or HyperShift topologies. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | The pull request does not violate the OTE Binary Stdout Contract. Changes are limited to conversion utilities, fuzz testing, and controller diff options with no process-level output code. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR does not add any new Ginkgo e2e tests. Changes are limited to conversion logic and controller synchronization for IPv6 field handling. | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The PR title accurately reflects the main changes: adding handling for the HTTPProtocolIPv6 field in AWS conversion and temporarily disabling its diffing. |
✏️ Tip: You can configure your own custom pre-merge checks in the settings.
